bug.title: A reporter's "kept" notice shows their own reason as if it were the moderator's; the bell's /me#notifications link opens at the top of the page
bug.symptoms: Reporter notifications for kept records read "...was reviewed and kept: Off topic." - the reporter's own reason reads as the reason for keeping, and the moderator's stated reason is never shown to the reporter The global-nav bell links to /me#notifications, but /me opens at the top instead of at the Notifications section (the section renders after data loads, so the browser's fragment scroll misses it)
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 07: report a post, as priya dismiss the flag with a reason, read the reporter's notification (screenshots/07-flag-and-dispute/) Journey 05: click the bell on any page while signed in (screenshots/05-follow-search-notify/)
bug.expected: Outcome notices for reporters read 'The post you reported as "Off topic" on "{title}" was reviewed and kept. Moderator's note: {decision reason}.' (and the equivalent for hidden/held/dismissed outcomes), with the moderator's reason taken from the decision record and the reporter's category labelled as theirs; /me scrolls the Notifications section into view (and moves focus to its heading) once it has rendered when the URL fragment is #notifications
bug.actual: Misattributed reason; bell lands at the top
